description: x.md is a read-only browser for public X content that returns posts, profiles, connections, and search results as Markdown or JSON. It mirrors X URLs onto mdfromx.com and also offers the same reads over MCP for AI agents.
summary: mdfromx.com exposes two public integration surfaces: a read-only HTTP API documented at /docs and an MCP server at https://mdfromx.com/mcp; both are callable without authentication, with an optional manually issued bearer key only to increase search allowance.
